stageTrace.text: Jax asked Nell Rudd straight out who in this city pays coin for what a newcomer can do. Nell Rudd said, "Buyers there are plenty, and honest buyers are thin on this ground." Col Thatch leaned one shoulder against the wall of Cathedral Close and watched the two of them with a still face.
